content.title: Red Lions edge a late, wild extra-time finish
paragraphs: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a match that swung back and forth before ending in a frantic final spell. Fox put Red Lions ahead in the 28th minute from Lane’s assist, Gray levelled for Blue Sharks in the 62nd minute, and Reid restored Red Lions’ lead in the 95th minute from Rook’s assist.

Blue Sharks answered in the 105th minute through Cruz, set up by Wells, but the decisive moment came in the 113th minute when Bell turned the ball into his own net. Red Lions finished with 27 shots to 15 and 11 on target to 7, while Blue Sharks still stayed alive with five big chances of their own.

The control was mostly Red Lions’ from start to finish: 69 possession, 85 field tilt and 110 entries into the final third across the match, backed by 93 passing accuracy. The last 10 minutes were chaotic, but Red Lions spent almost all of that spell on the front foot, and that territorial push helped them see it out at 120+1' after a match full of momentum shifts.
